usage: The word 半斤 (bun3 gan1) is used to indicate half a catty, a common unit of weight in Hong Kong.
It functions as a noun to specify a quantity of weight, typically for food or groceries.
It can be used alone or together with other nouns to describe specific items weighed in half a catty.
半斤 is countable when talking about amounts, e.g., '一半斤' means one half catty.
It is often used in everyday market conversations and informal settings related to buying and selling.
